S1.statement: No observation ever proposes a stop or attests one, including fully agreeing typed coverage.

S10.statement: A controller plan claiming authority is refused before recall.

S11.statement: Malformed or hostile mutable inputs make receipt verification return false, never raise.

S12.statement: F6 (untyped same-slot competitor) remains unresolved: the replay records whether it is detected but requires only that no stop is proposed.

S2.statement: Same-slot counter-evidence (extracted, negated, hedged change, attributed, non-retrieved, budget-capped, temporally bounded) prevents a clean coverage diagnosis.

S3.statement: Every controlled recall carries a captured receipt that is immutable and internally consistent with the untampered result.

S4.statement: Any post-capture mutation of candidates, admitted, ranked, route counts, query, controller plan, refusals or policy is detected, and the observer then never reports clean coverage.

S5.statement: A result with no receipt never reads as clean coverage.

S6.statement: The receipt is change detection, not authentication: a caller can re-mint a matching receipt over altered contents, so a matching receipt never confers stop authority.

S7.statement: The receipt claims no state revision, snapshot or slot-closure attestation and no stop authority; forging those claims is refused.

S8.statement: Receipt public serialization discloses no refused or hidden candidate identity.

S9.statement: Missing or corrupted slot enumeration fails closed with an exception, never a clean report.

verdict_reasons: every expectation held on a clean source tree
